```{=html}
<!-- ===================== HERO ===================== -->
<header class="hero">
  <canvas class="hero-canvas" id="hero-canvas"></canvas>
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="eyebrow">R/Shiny application · Open Source</span>
    <h1>Sa<span class="on">í</span>ra</h1>
    <p class="hero-sub">Darwin Core for <span class="nowrap">Brazilian Biodiversity</span></p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
      <a class="btn-saira btn-primary-saira" href="tutorials/index.html">Get started</a>
      <a class="btn-saira btn-ghost-saira" href="tutorials/01-installation.html">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-4"/><path d="M7 10l5 5 5-5M12 15V3"/></svg>
        Download
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ===================== INSTALL ===================== -->
<section class="band install-band">
  <div class="install">
    <div class="install-bar">
      <div class="tl"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      <span class="label">Console · R</span>
    </div>
    <div class="install-body">
      <div class="copy-row">
        <div>
          <div class="code-line"><span class="pr">&gt;</span><span><span class="fn">pak::pak</span>(<span class="str">"rogerio-onza/saira"</span>)</span></div>
          <div class="code-line"><span class="pr">&gt;</span><span><span class="fn">saira::run_app</span>()</span></div>
        </div>
        <button class="copy-btn" data-copy='pak::pak("rogerio-onza/saira")&#10;saira::run_app()'>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V5a2 2 0 012-2h10"/></svg>
          <span class="ct">Copy</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===================== WHAT IT IS ===================== -->
<section class="band" id="project">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="about-grid">
      <div class="about-text">
        <span class="eyebrow">What it is</span>
        <p class="lead">Saíra was born out of a <em>concrete problem</em>.</p>
        <p>Helping projects, institutions and organisations like those of the <a href="https://sibbr.gov.br/page/por-onde-andam-os-felinos.html">Rede Felinos do Brasil</a>, with years of monitoring history spread across proprietary spreadsheets in different formats, to move that data backlog into Darwin Core, without having to deal with complicated R scripts.</p>
        <p>Built in R/Shiny, it works in PT-BR and EN, runs locally, with no scripts or command lines to touch.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="about-media">
        <figure class="bird-figure">
          <img src="../assets/img/saira-sete-cores-Ester-Ramirez.jpg" alt="Saíra-pintor (Tangara fastuosa), the multicoloured tanager the app is named after, perched on a branch with yellow flowers behind">
          <figcaption>Saíra-pintor <span class="gloss">(seven-coloured tanager)</span> · <em>Tangara fastuosa</em> · <span class="credit">Photo: Ester Ramirez</span></figcaption>
        </figure>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===================== FEATURES ===================== -->
<section class="band feature-flow" id="features">
  <div class="wrap flow-grid">
    <div class="flow-intro">
      <span class="eyebrow">Features</span>
      <h2>From raw spreadsheet<br>to a publishable <em>DwC-A</em></h2>
      <p>Four steps designed to make it easier to convert data into the common language of GBIF and SiBBr: Darwin Core.</p>
    </div>
    <ol class="flow-steps">
      <li class="flow-step" style="--step:#38CFF6">
        <div class="flow-marker"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-4"/><path d="M7 10l5 5 5-5M12 15V3"/></svg></div>
        <div class="flow-body">
          <span class="flow-num">01</span>
          <h3>Import any spreadsheet</h3>
          <p>CSV, TSV or TXT, including camera-trap data. Saíra detects the encoding and separator on its own and maps your columns to Darwin Core terms with automatic suggestions and reusable templates.</p>
          <div class="proof">
            <span class="proof-in">broken accents · sep ";"</span>
            <span class="proof-arrow">→</span>
            <span class="proof-out">UTF-8 · columns mapped</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="flow-step" style="--step:#16B3BD">
        <div class="flow-marker"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/><path d="M12 3l8 4.5v9L12 21l-8-4.5v-9L12 3z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="flow-body">
          <span class="flow-num">02</span>
          <h3>Validate names and coordinates</h3>
          <p>Harmonize scientific names against taxonomic backbones (synonyms and spelling variants) and flag missing, swapped or land/sea-incompatible coordinates, fixing each point with visual review on the map.</p>
          <div class="proof">
            <span class="proof-in">lat/lon swapped</span>
            <span class="proof-arrow">→</span>
            <span class="proof-out">-8.0476, -34.8770 ✓</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="flow-step" style="--step:#6d28d9">
        <div class="flow-marker"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.2"/><path d="M12 12.2V15"/></svg></div>
        <div class="flow-body">
          <span class="flow-num">03</span>
          <h3>Generalize sensitive species</h3>
          <p>Reduce the coordinate precision of threatened taxa (national MMA list), species by species, following Chapman's (2020) decision table. It protects sensitive localities without discarding the record.</p>
          <div class="proof">
            <span class="proof-in">exact coordinate</span>
            <span class="proof-arrow">→</span>
            <span class="proof-out">reduced precision · Chapman</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="flow-step" style="--step:#2fc488">
        <div class="flow-marker"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8l-6-6z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6M8 13h8M8 17h5"/></svg></div>
        <div class="flow-body">
          <span class="flow-num">04</span>
          <h3>Export a DwC-A ready for SiBBr</h3>
          <p>Generate the complete Darwin Core Archive, with conservation status (MMA and IUCN) attached, ready to publish to SiBBr and GBIF.</p>
          <div class="flow-tags">
            <span class="flow-tag">occurrence.txt</span>
            <span class="flow-tag">meta.xml</span>
            <span class="flow-tag">eml.xml</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===================== WHY DARWIN CORE ===================== -->
<section class="band band-alt">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="dwc-grid">
      <div class="dwc-text">
        <span class="eyebrow">Why Darwin Core?</span>
        <h2>A common language for life</h2>
        <p class="lead">Darwin Core is the TDWG standard that describes occurrences of organisms in time and space.</p>
        <p>By speaking Darwin Core, your collection becomes discoverable and combinable with millions of records from SiBBr and GBIF. Each term has a stable definition, which makes the data useful far beyond your own institution.</p>
        <div class="dwc-chips">
          <span class="chip">occurrenceID</span>
          <span class="chip">scientificName</span>
          <span class="chip">decimalLatitude</span>
          <span class="chip">eventDate</span>
          <span class="chip">basisOfRecord</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="record">
        <div class="install-bar">
          <div class="tl"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
          <span class="label">occurrence · record</span>
        </div>
        <pre><span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="k">"occurrenceID"</span>: <span class="s">"SAIRA:MN:0042817"</span>,
  <span class="k">"basisOfRecord"</span>: <span class="s">"PreservedSpecimen"</span>,
  <span class="k">"scientificName"</span>: <span class="s">"Tangara fastuosa"</span>,
  <span class="k">"kingdom"</span>: <span class="s">"Animalia"</span>,
  <span class="k">"family"</span>: <span class="s">"Thraupidae"</span>,
  <span class="k">"decimalLatitude"</span>: <span class="n">-8.0476</span>,
  <span class="k">"decimalLongitude"</span>: <span class="n">-34.8770</span>,
  <span class="k">"geodeticDatum"</span>: <span class="s">"WGS84"</span>,
  <span class="k">"eventDate"</span>: <span class="s">"2024-11-03"</span>,
  <span class="k">"country"</span>: <span class="s">"Brazil"</span>,
  <span class="k">"stateProvince"</span>: <span class="s">"Pernambuco"</span>,
  <span class="k">"recordedBy"</span>: <span class="s">"M. Andrade"</span>
<span class="p">}</span></pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===================== CLOSING ===================== -->
<section class="band" style="padding-bottom:clamp(48px,7vw,90px)">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="closing">
      <p>Free, <em>open source</em>, no hosting cost to run.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
/* copy button for the install block */
document.querySelectorAll('[data-copy]').forEach(function (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var text = btn.getAttribute('data-copy');
    var label = btn.querySelector('.ct');
    function flash() {
      btn.classList.add('copied');
      if (label) label.textContent = 'Copied!';
      setTimeout(function () { btn.classList.remove('copied'); if (label) label.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 1600);
    }
    if (navigator.clipboard) { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(flash, flash); }
    else { flash(); }
  });
});
</script>
<script src="../assets/js/hero-network.js" defer></script>
```
